mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM plat_tenant_storage_sources WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM file_upload_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND (status = 'CLEANUP' OR (status IN ('INIT', 'TRANSFERRING') AND expire_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_object WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND storage_id = #{storageId} AND object_key = #{objectKey} AND deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_upload_session WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND storage_id = #{storageId} AND object_key = #{objectKey} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('INIT','TRANSFERRING','CLEANUP'))

SELECT f.storage_id, f.object_key, f.file_size, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.file_size) FROM sys_export_task e WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 'COMPLETED' AND CAST(e.object_key AS BINARY) = CAST(f.object_key AS BINARY)), 0) AS billed_export_bytes FROM file_object f WHERE f.id = #{fileId} AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND f.deleted = 1

SELECT s.id, s.tenant_id, t.tenant_code FROM file_upload_session s JOIN plat_tenant t ON t.id = s.tenant_id WHERE s.quota_managed = 1 AND s.deleted = 0 AND ((s.status IN ('INIT', 'TRANSFERRING') AND s.expire_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (s.status = 'CLEANUP' AND s.cleanup_after <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.cleanup_after, s.expire_at), s.id LIMIT 100

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, bucket_id AS bucketId, storage_id AS storageId, session_code AS sessionCode, object_key AS objectKey, file_name AS fileName, file_size AS fileSize, upload_mode AS uploadMode, part_count AS partCount, owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, status, expire_at AS expireAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM file_upload_session WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
